blocks.text: Thermoregulation woh homeostatic amal hai jis ke zariye jandar apne jism ka andar ka darja-e-hararat ek qabil-e-bardasht (tolerable) had mein rakhte hain, chahe bahar ka darja-e-hararat kuch bhi ho.

Thermoregulation janwaron ke liye bohat zaroori hai. Hum jante hain ke har enzyme ka ek behtareen (optimal) darja-e-hararat hota hai jis par woh sab se achha kaam karta hai. Agar darja-e-hararat is se kam ho jaye to enzyme aur substrate ki takkar (collisions) kam ho jati hai aur metabolism ki raftar gir jati hai. Agar darja-e-hararat is se bohat zyada ho jaye to enzymes denature ho jate hain (in ki shakal bigar jati hai) aur hamesha ke liye kaam chhor dete hain. Isi tarah cell membrane ki lipid bilayer (charbi ki dohri tah) bhi darja-e-hararat se mutasir hoti hai. Zyada garmi mein cell membranes apni selective permeability (sirf chuni hui cheezon ko guzarne dena) kho sakti hain. Kam darja-e-hararat membranes ko sakht aur bhurbhura (rigid aur brittle) bana sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Thermoregulation ki tareef kijiye aur iski zaroorat samjhaiye.
blocks.explanation: Yeh jism ka darja-e-hararat mehfooz had mein rakhta hai; zaroori is liye ke enzymes thand mein sust aur zyada garmi mein denature hote hain, aur jhilliyan thand mein bhurbhuri aur garmi mein risne wali ho jati hain.

items: Thermoregulation: bahar ka darja-e-hararat kuch bhi ho, jism ka andar ka darja-e-hararat had mein rakhna.
Kam darja-e-hararat: enzymes sust, metabolism kam; membranes sakht aur bhurbhuri.
Zyada darja-e-hararat: enzymes denature; membranes selective permeability kho deti hain.
